Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
The

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Hatem Abd El Daim, tested by eng. Samy Shehata 
Ibrahem, accepted by eng. Hanafy Fahmy Madany: general director, approved 
by eng. Abd El-kreem Abu Zaid: head sector of High Dam Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Stop pump and switch off the power supply.
Close the out let and inlet valves and put suitable warning boards.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrench
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating
Cleaning material

Stop pump and switch off the power supply and close the out let and 
 inlet valves.
Dismantle the coupling.
Dismantle the shaft and impeller and protection and cooling pushing and 
 check for defects or cracks.
Check key and change if need.
Check the bearings if need.
Install the pump and alingment with motor.
Install the coupling.
Operate the pump and check the load current.
